text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky doesn't show up for practice, but I haven't given up on her yet. I compile the data from her training and races up until now in the hopes they might be of use.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the data in hand, I go to visit Seiun Sky. She explains that she's reached her limit and that her time is now up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last she opens up, tears brimming in her eyes. She wants to win, but she feels like there's this impenetrable wall standing between her and victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hand her the documents and promise her we can break down that wall together. She will find a way—all we can do now is believe.
